what: A hardcore break chopper: breaks cut into 16 slices on the white keys, effect pads on the black keys, a kick with its own synth, DISTO distortion, a KICK LAB (a clean tail, its note, layering) and reverse bass, a snare, a hat and a clap, a 64-step sequencer with conditions, tracks with built-up drops, and screen effects: kicks and drums only. A fork of CHOPPAH.
author: FLEXOR
